#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Thermal Cartography design philosophy. REFINED."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

W, H = 4960, 7016
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# --- PALETTE ---
NAVY = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE = (30, 42, 58)
DARK_SLATE = (20, 34, 50)
AMBER = (245, 166, 35)
VERMILION = (231, 76, 60)
DEEP_RED = (192, 57, 43)
TEAL = (46, 204, 157)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (176, 190, 197)
MID_GRAY = (100, 120, 140)
FAINT_LINE = (40, 58, 82)
WARM_DARK = (45, 25, 25)

def fp(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

# --- FONTS ---
f_title = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 152)
f_subtitle = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 58)
f_section_head = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_metric_big = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 200)
f_metric_hero = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260)
f_metric_label = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_body = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 50)
f_body_bold = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_small = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_tiny = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 33)
f_scenario_val = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_scenario_label = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_source = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_section_num = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_callout_num = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 180)
f_callout_word = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 72)
f_target_big = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 240)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

ML = 240
MR = 240
CW = W - ML - MR

# === SUBTLE BACKGROUND GRID ===
for x in range(ML, W - MR, 140):
    draw.line([(x, 0), (x, H)], fill=(14, 32, 60), width=1)

# === TOP ACCENT BAR ===
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (W, 10)], fill=VERMILION)

y = 70

# === HEADER ===
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 500, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 24
draw.text((ML, y), "IPCC  AR6  SYNTHESIS  REPORT  ·  2023", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 64

for line in ["Climate Change 2023", "Key Findings from the IPCC", "Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report"]:
    draw.text((ML, y), line, fill=WHITE, font=f_title)
    y += 168

y += 20
draw.text((ML, y), "A visual summary of the most critical findings from the IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report,", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_subtitle)
y += 72
draw.text((ML, y), "highlighting observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_subtitle)
y += 110

draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
y += 40

# ===================================================================
# SECTION 01 — HEADLINE METRICS
# ===================================================================
strip_top = y
strip_h = 840
draw.rectangle([(0, strip_top), (W, strip_top + strip_h)], fill=DARK_SLATE)
draw.rectangle([(0, strip_top), (W, strip_top + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
draw.rectangle([(0, strip_top + strip_h - 2), (W, strip_top + strip_h)], fill=FAINT_LINE)

y = strip_top + 25
draw.text((ML, y), "01", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
draw.text((ML + 70, y), "HEADLINE  METRICS", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
y += 60

# Row 1: 4 metrics
metrics_r1 = [
    ("+1.1°C", "Global temperature rise\n2011–2020 vs 1850–1900", AMBER),
    ("410 ppm", "Atmospheric CO₂\nHighest in 2 million years", AMBER),
    ("~59 Gt", "CO₂e global emissions\n2019", AMBER),
    ("~500 Gt", "Remaining carbon budget\nfor 1.5°C (from 2020)", AMBER),
]
col_w4 = CW // 4
for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(metrics_r1):
    cx = ML + i * col_w4
    draw.text((cx, y), val, fill=color, font=f_metric_big)
    for j, ln in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
        draw.text((cx, y + 210 + j * 48), ln, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_metric_label)
y += 360

# Row 2: 3 metrics (hero emphasis on 43% and 3.3-3.6B)
col_w3 = CW // 3
metrics_r2 = [
    ("43%", "Required GHG reduction\nby 2030 for 1.5°C", VERMILION, True),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea level rise\n1901–2018", AMBER, False),
    ("3.3–3.6B", "People exposed to\nsevere climate hazards", DEEP_RED, True),
]
for i, (val, label, color, hero) in enumerate(metrics_r2):
    cx = ML + i * col_w3
    fnt = f_metric_hero if hero else f_metric_big
    draw.text((cx, y), val, fill=color, font=fnt)
    ly = y + (270 if hero else 210)
    for j, ln in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
        draw.text((cx, ly + j * 48), ln, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_metric_label)

y = strip_top + strip_h + 50

# ===================================================================
# SECTION 02 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ===================================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "02", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
draw.text((ML + 70, y), "OBSERVED  CHANGES  AND  CURRENT  STATE", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
y += 60
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 28

col_right = ML + CW // 2 + 50

obs_left = [
    "Global surface temperature has risen +1.1°C above",
    "pre-industrial levels. Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm —",
    "the highest concentration in at least 2 million years.",
]
obs_right = [
    "Arctic sea ice has declined ~40% since 1979. Every",
    "region has experienced intensifying extreme weather",
    "events with clear attribution to human influence.",
]
for i, line in enumerate(obs_left):
    draw.text((ML, y + i * 60), line, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
for i, line in enumerate(obs_right):
    draw.text((col_right, y + i * 60), line, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
y += 220

# Indicator bars
indicators = [
    ("Temperature", "+1.1°C", 0.55, AMBER),
    ("CO₂", "410 ppm", 0.75, AMBER),
    ("Emissions", "59 GtCO₂e", 0.65, VERMILION),
    ("Sea Level", "+0.20 m", 0.35, AMBER),
    ("Arctic Ice", "~40%", 0.40, TEAL),
]
bar_h = 32
bar_max_w = CW - 480
for i, (name, val, pct, color) in enumerate(indicators):
    by = y + i * 56
    draw.text((ML, by + 2), name, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_small)
    bar_x = ML + 340
    draw.rectangle([(bar_x, by + 6), (bar_x + bar_max_w, by + 6 + bar_h)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
    draw.rectangle([(bar_x, by + 6), (bar_x + int(bar_max_w * pct), by + 6 + bar_h)], fill=color)
    draw.text((bar_x + bar_max_w + 24, by + 2), val, fill=WHITE, font=f_small)
y += 330

draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
y += 45

# ===================================================================
# SECTION 03 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS (SSP scenarios)
# ===================================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "03", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
draw.text((ML + 70, y), "FUTURE  PROJECTIONS  UNDER  DIFFERENT  SCENARIOS", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
y += 60
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 35

scenarios = [
    ("SSP1-1.9", "~1.4°C", "Very low emissions", TEAL),
    ("SSP1-2.6", "~1.8°C", "Low emissions", (80, 180, 140)),
    ("SSP2-4.5", "~2.7°C", "Intermediate", AMBER),
    ("SSP3-7.0", "~3.6°C", "High emissions", VERMILION),
    ("SSP5-8.5", "~4.4°C", "Very high emissions", DEEP_RED),
]

# Horizontal strip layout: each scenario gets a row with a thermal bar
row_h = 90
label_x = ML
temp_x = ML + 340
bar_start = ML + 680
bar_max = CW - 680 - 500
desc_x = W - MR - 460

for i, (ssp, temp, desc, color) in enumerate(scenarios):
    ry = y + i * row_h
    # SSP label
    draw.text((label_x, ry + 10), ssp, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_scenario_label)
    # Temperature value
    draw.text((temp_x, ry - 10), temp, fill=color, font=f_scenario_val)
    # Thermal bar — length proportional to temperature
    temp_val = float(temp.replace("~", "").replace("°C", ""))
    bar_len = int((temp_val / 5.0) * bar_max)
    draw.rectangle([(bar_start, ry + 22), (bar_start + bar_len, ry + 22 + 46)], fill=color)
    # Description
    draw.text((desc_x, ry + 25), desc, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_scenario_label)

y += len(scenarios) * row_h + 20

# Sea level annotation
draw.text((ML, y), "Sea level rise by 2100:", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_small)
draw.text((ML + 480, y), "0.28–0.55 m", fill=TEAL, font=f_body_bold)
draw.text((ML + 830, y), "(SSP1-1.9)  to", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_small)
draw.text((ML + 1130, y), "0.63–1.01 m", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_body_bold)
draw.text((ML + 1480, y), "(SSP5-8.5)   ·   Continued rise for centuries regardless of pathway", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_small)
y += 80

draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
y += 45

# ===================================================================
# SECTION 04 — RISKS & IMPACTS
# ===================================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "04", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
draw.text((ML + 70, y), "RISKS,  VULNERABILITIES  AND  CASCADING  IMPACTS", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
y += 60
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=DEEP_RED)
y += 35

# Hero callout
draw.text((ML, y), "3.3–3.6", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_callout_num)
draw.text((ML + 820, y + 20), "BILLION PEOPLE", fill=WHITE, font=f_callout_word)
draw.text((ML + 820, y + 110), "live in contexts highly vulnerable to climate change", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_body)
y += 210

# Impact cards — three columns
impacts = [
    ("FOOD SECURITY", ["Crop yield growth slowing.", "Fisheries declining in", "tropical zones."], VERMILION),
    ("WATER STRESS", ["Over half of global population", "faces severe water scarcity", "at least 1 month per year."], AMBER),
    ("HEALTH & BIODIVERSITY", ["Heat mortality expanding.", "14% of terrestrial species", "face high extinction risk at 1.5°C."], DEEP_RED),
]
card_w = (CW - 80) // 3
card_h = 260
for i, (title, lines, color) in enumerate(impacts):
    cx = ML + i * (card_w + 40)
    draw.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + card_w, y + card_h)], fill=SLATE)
    draw.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + card_w, y + 5)], fill=color)
    draw.text((cx + 28, y + 24), title, fill=color, font=f_tiny)
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        draw.text((cx + 28, y + 74 + j * 50), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_small)
y += card_h + 50

draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
y += 45

# ===================================================================
# SECTION 05 — MITIGATION PATHWAYS
# ===================================================================
draw.text((ML, y), "05", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
draw.text((ML + 70, y), "MITIGATION  AND  ADAPTATION  PATHWAYS", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
y += 60
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=TEAL)
y += 35

# Two target columns
half = CW // 2 - 60

# 1.5°C
draw.text((ML, y), "43%", fill=VERMILION, font=f_target_big)
draw.text((ML, y + 250), "reduction in global GHG emissions", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
draw.text((ML, y + 310), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_body)
draw.text((ML, y + 380), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2050", fill=TEAL, font=f_body_bold)

# 2°C
rx = ML + half + 120
draw.text((rx, y), "27%", fill=AMBER, font=f_target_big)
draw.text((rx, y + 250), "reduction for 2°C pathway", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
draw.text((rx, y + 310), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_body)
draw.text((rx, y + 380), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2070", fill=TEAL, font=f_body_bold)

y += 460

# Key levers
levers = ["Energy decarbonization", "Transport electrification", "Demand-side efficiency", "Carbon sink protection"]
draw.text((ML, y), "KEY LEVERS", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 46
for i, lever in enumerate(levers):
    lx = ML + i * (CW // 4)
    draw.rectangle([(lx, y + 8), (lx + 18, y + 26)], fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((lx + 32, y), lever, fill=WHITE, font=f_small)
y += 70

draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
y += 40

# ===================================================================
# SECTION 06 — THE NARROWING WINDOW
# ===================================================================
nw_top = y
nw_h = 500
for row in range(nw_h):
    t = row / nw_h
    r = int(NAVY[0] + t * (WARM_DARK[0] - NAVY[0]))
    g = int(NAVY[1] + t * (WARM_DARK[1] - NAVY[1]))
    b = int(NAVY[2] + t * (WARM_DARK[2] - NAVY[2]))
    draw.line([(0, nw_top + row), (W, nw_top + row)], fill=(r, g, b))

draw.text((ML, y), "06", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
draw.text((ML + 70, y), "THE  NARROWING  WINDOW  FOR  ACTION", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
y += 60
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 35

draw.text((ML, y), "This decade is decisive.", fill=WHITE, font=f_section_head)
y += 110

for line in [
    "Delayed action increases costs, locks in high-carbon infrastructure, and reduces",
    "feasibility of limiting warming. Climate finance falls short by a factor of 3–6×.",
]:
    draw.text((ML, y), line, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
    y += 60

y += 25
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 5, y + 70)], fill=VERMILION)
draw.text((ML + 28, y), "Immediate, deep, and sustained emissions reductions", fill=AMBER, font=f_body_bold)
draw.text((ML + 28, y + 56), "across all sectors are essential to secure a liveable future.", fill=AMBER, font=f_body_bold)

y = nw_top + nw_h + 30

# === FOOTER ===
draw.rectangle([(0, y), (W, y + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
y += 20
draw.text((ML, y), "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_source)
y += 42
draw.text((ML, y), "Presented at IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Dissemination — Climate Science Conference", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_source)

draw.rectangle([(0, H - 10), (W, H)], fill=VERMILION)

img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px, y_end={y}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Thermal Cartography design philosophy. REFINED."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

W, H = 4960, 7016
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# --- PALETTE ---
NAVY = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE = (30, 42, 58)
DARK_SLATE = (20, 34, 50)
AMBER = (245, 166, 35)
VERMILION = (231, 76, 60)
DEEP_RED = (192, 57, 43)
TEAL = (46, 204, 157)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LIGHT_GRAY = (176, 190, 197)
MID_GRAY = (100, 120, 140)
FAINT_LINE = (40, 58, 82)
WARM_DARK = (45, 25, 25)

def fp(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

# --- FONTS ---
f_title = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 152)
f_subtitle = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 58)
f_section_head = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_metric_big = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 200)
f_metric_hero = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260)
f_metric_label = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_body = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 50)
f_body_bold = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_small = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_tiny = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 33)
f_scenario_val = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_scenario_label = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_source = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_section_num = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_callout_num = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 180)
f_callout_word = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 72)
f_target_big = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 240)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

ML = 240
MR = 240
CW = W - ML - MR

# === SUBTLE BACKGROUND GRID ===
for x in range(ML, W - MR, 140):
    draw.line([(x, 0), (x, H)], fill=(14, 32, 60), width=1)

# === TOP ACCENT BAR ===
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (W, 10)], fill=VERMILION)

y = 70

# === HEADER ===
draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 500, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 24
draw.text((ML, y), "IPCC  AR6  SYNTHESIS  REPORT  ·  2023", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 64

for line in ["Climate Change 2023", "Key Findings from the IPCC", "Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report"]:
    draw.text((ML, y), line, fill=WHITE, font=f_title)
    y += 168

y += 20
draw.text((ML, y), "A visual summary of the most critical findings from the IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report,", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_subtitle)
y += 72
draw.text((ML, y), "highlighting observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.", fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=f_subtitle)
y += 110

draw.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
y += 40

# ===================================================================
# SECTION 01 — HEADLINE METRICS
# ===================================================================
strip_top = y
strip_h = 840
draw.rectangle([(0, strip_top), (W, strip_top + strip_h)], fill=DARK_SLATE)
draw.rectangle([(0, strip_top), (W, strip_top + 2)], fill=FAINT_LINE)
draw.rectangle([(0, strip_top + strip_h - 2), (W, strip_top + strip_h)], fill=FAINT_LINE)

y = strip_top + 25
draw.text((ML, y), "01", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
draw.text((ML + 70, y), "HEADLINE  METRICS", fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_section_num)
y += 60

# Row 1: 4 metrics
metrics_r1 = [
    ("+1.1°C", "Global temperature rise\n2011–2020 vs 1850–1900", AMBER),

"""IPCC AR6 Poster — Thermal Cartography. A0 portrait, full-height."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 4960, 7016
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE = (30, 42, 58)
DARK_SLATE = (20, 34, 50)
AMBER = (245, 166, 35)
VERMILION = (231, 76, 60)
DEEP_RED = (192, 57, 43)
TEAL = (46, 204, 157)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LGRAY = (176, 190, 197)
MGRAY = (100, 120, 140)
FLINE = (40, 58, 82)
WARM_DARK = (50, 25, 25)

def fp(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

f_title = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 168)
f_sub = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 62)
f_sec = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 88)
f_mbig = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 230)
f_mhero = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 300)
f_mlbl = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_body = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
f_bbold = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_tiny = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sval = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)
f_slbl = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_src = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_snum = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_cnum = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 200)
f_cword = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_tbig = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 280)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

ML, MR = 260, 260
CW = W - ML - MR

# Background grid
for x in range(ML, W - MR, 140):
    d.line([(x, 0), (x, H)], fill=(14, 32, 60), width=1)

# Top accent
d.rectangle([(0, 0), (W, 10)], fill=VERMILION)

y = 90
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 500, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 28
d.text((ML, y), "IPCC  AR6  SYNTHESIS  REPORT  ·  2023", fill=LGRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 72

for ln in ["Climate Change 2023", "Key Findings from the IPCC", "Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report"]:
    d.text((ML, y), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_title)
    y += 186
y += 30
d.text((ML, y), "A visual summary of the most critical findings from the IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report,", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sub)
y += 78
d.text((ML, y), "highlighting observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sub)
y += 120
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 50

# ===== 01 HEADLINE METRICS =====
st = y
sh = 1020
d.rectangle([(0, st), (W, st + sh)], fill=DARK_SLATE)
d.rectangle([(0, st), (W, st + 2)], fill=FLINE)
d.rectangle([(0, st + sh - 2), (W, st + sh)], fill=FLINE)

y = st + 30
d.text((ML, y), "01", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "HEADLINE  METRICS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 70

# Row 1
c4 = CW // 4
for i, (v, l, c) in enumerate([
    ("+1.1°C", "Global temperature rise\n2011–2020 vs 1850–1900", AMBER),
    ("410 ppm", "Atmospheric CO₂\nHighest in 2 million years", AMBER),
    ("~59 Gt", "CO₂e global emissions\n2019", AMBER),
    ("~500 Gt", "Remaining carbon budget\nfor 1.5°C (from 2020)", AMBER),
]):
    cx = ML + i * c4
    d.text((cx, y), v, fill=c, font=f_mbig)
    for j, t in enumerate(l.split("\n")):
        d.text((cx, y + 240 + j * 52), t, fill=LGRAY, font=f_mlbl)

y += 420

# Row 2 — hero metrics
c3 = CW // 3
for i, (v, l, c, hero) in enumerate([
    ("43%", "Required GHG reduction\nby 2030 for 1.5°C", VERMILION, True),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea level rise\n1901–2018", AMBER, False),
    ("3.3–3.6B", "People exposed to\nsevere climate hazards", DEEP_RED, True),
]):
    cx = ML + i * c3
    fnt = f_mhero if hero else f_mbig
    d.text((cx, y), v, fill=c, font=fnt)
    oy = y + (310 if hero else 240)
    for j, t in enumerate(l.split("\n")):
        d.text((cx, oy + j * 52), t, fill=LGRAY, font=f_mlbl)

y = st + sh + 65

# ===== 02 OBSERVED CHANGES =====
d.text((ML, y), "02", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "OBSERVED  CHANGES  AND  CURRENT  STATE", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 35

cr = ML + CW // 2 + 60
for i, ln in enumerate([
    "Global surface temperature has risen +1.1°C above",
    "pre-industrial levels. Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm —",
    "the highest concentration in at least 2 million years.",
]):
    d.text((ML, y + i * 66), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
for i, ln in enumerate([
    "Arctic sea ice has declined ~40% since 1979. Every",
    "region has experienced intensifying extreme weather",
    "events with clear attribution to human influence.",
]):
    d.text((cr, y + i * 66), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
y += 250

# Indicator bars
bh, bmw = 36, CW - 520
for i, (nm, vl, pct, col) in enumerate([
    ("Temperature", "+1.1°C", 0.55, AMBER),
    ("CO₂", "410 ppm", 0.75, AMBER),
    ("Emissions", "59 GtCO₂e", 0.65, VERMILION),
    ("Sea Level", "+0.20 m", 0.35, AMBER),
    ("Arctic Ice", "~40%", 0.40, TEAL),
]):
    by = y + i * 62
    d.text((ML, by + 4), nm, fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
    bx = ML + 370
    d.rectangle([(bx, by + 8), (bx + bmw, by + 8 + bh)], fill=FLINE)
    d.rectangle([(bx, by + 8), (bx + int(bmw * pct), by + 8 + bh)], fill=col)
    d.text((bx + bmw + 26, by + 4), vl, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += 380

d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 03 FUTURE PROJECTIONS =====
d.text((ML, y), "03", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "FUTURE  PROJECTIONS  UNDER  DIFFERENT  SCENARIOS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 40

# Horizontal thermal bars per scenario
rh = 106
lx, tx, bx0 = ML, ML + 380, ML + 740
bmx = CW - 740 - 540
dx = W - MR - 500
for i, (ssp, tmp, desc, col) in enumerate([
    ("SSP1-1.9", "~1.4°C", "Very low emissions", TEAL),
    ("SSP1-2.6", "~1.8°C", "Low emissions", (80, 180, 140)),
    ("SSP2-4.5", "~2.7°C", "Intermediate", AMBER),
    ("SSP3-7.0", "~3.6°C", "High emissions", VERMILION),
    ("SSP5-8.5", "~4.4°C", "Very high emissions", DEEP_RED),
]):
    ry = y + i * rh
    d.text((lx, ry + 14), ssp, fill=LGRAY, font=f_slbl)
    d.text((tx, ry - 8), tmp, fill=col, font=f_sval)
    tv = float(tmp.replace("~", "").replace("°C", ""))
    bl = int((tv / 5.0) * bmx)
    d.rectangle([(bx0, ry + 24), (bx0 + bl, ry + 24 + 52)], fill=col)
    d.text((dx, ry + 30), desc, fill=MGRAY, font=f_slbl)

y += 5 * rh + 25
d.text((ML, y), "Sea level rise by 2100:", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
d.text((ML + 500, y), "0.28–0.55 m", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 870, y), "(SSP1-1.9)  to", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
d.text((ML + 1170, y), "0.63–1.01 m", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 1550, y), "(SSP5-8.5)  ·  Rise continues for centuries", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
y += 100
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 04 RISKS & IMPACTS =====
d.text((ML, y), "04", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "RISKS,  VULNERABILITIES  AND  CASCADING  IMPACTS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=DEEP_RED)
y += 40

d.text((ML, y), "3.3–3.6", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_cnum)
d.text((ML + 880, y + 25), "BILLION PEOPLE", fill=WHITE, font=f_cword)
d.text((ML + 880, y + 120), "live in contexts highly vulnerable to climate change", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
y += 250

# Impact cards
cw = (CW - 100) // 3
ch = 300
for i, (title, lines, col) in enumerate([
    ("FOOD SECURITY", ["Crop yield growth slowing.", "Fisheries declining in", "tropical zones."], VERMILION),
    ("WATER STRESS", ["Over half of global population", "faces severe water scarcity", "at least 1 month per year."], AMBER),
    ("HEALTH & BIODIVERSITY", ["Heat mortality expanding.", "14% of terrestrial species face", "high extinction risk at 1.5°C."], DEEP_RED),
]):
    cx = ML + i * (cw + 50)
    d.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + cw, y + ch)], fill=SLATE)
    d.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + cw, y + 5)], fill=col)
    d.text((cx + 30, y + 28), title, fill=col, font=f_tiny)
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        d.text((cx + 30, y + 84 + j * 56), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += ch + 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 05 MITIGATION PATHWAYS =====
d.text((ML, y), "05", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "MITIGATION  AND  ADAPTATION  PATHWAYS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=TEAL)
y += 40

half = CW // 2 - 60
d.text((ML, y), "43%", fill=VERMILION, font=f_tbig)
d.text((ML, y + 290), "reduction in global GHG emissions", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
d.text((ML, y + 356), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
d.text((ML, y + 430), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2050", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)

rx = ML + half + 120
d.text((rx, y), "27%", fill=AMBER, font=f_tbig)
d.text((rx, y + 290), "reduction for 2°C pathway", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
d.text((rx, y + 356), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
d.text((rx, y + 430), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2070", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)
y += 520

d.text((ML, y), "KEY LEVERS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 52
for i, lv in enumerate(["Energy decarbonization", "Transport electrification", "Demand-side efficiency", "Carbon sink protection"]):
    lx2 = ML + i * (CW // 4)
    d.rectangle([(lx2, y + 10), (lx2 + 20, y + 30)], fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx2 + 36, y), lv, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += 90
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 50

# ===== 06 NARROWING WINDOW =====
nt = y
nh = H - nt - 120  # fill remaining
for row in range(nh):
    t = row / nh
    r = int(NAVY[0] + t * (WARM_DARK[0] - NAVY[0]))
    g = int(NAVY[1] + t * (WARM_DARK[1] - NAVY[1]))
    b = int(NAVY[2] + t * (WARM_DARK[2] - NAVY[2]))
    d.line([(0, nt + row), (W, nt + row)], fill=(r, g, b))

d.text((ML, y), "06", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "THE  NARROWING  WINDOW  FOR  ACTION", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 45

d.text((ML, y), "This decade is decisive.", fill=WHITE, font=f_sec)
y += 130

for ln in [
    "Delayed action increases costs, locks in high-carbon infrastructure, and reduces feasibility",
    "of limiting warming. Climate finance falls short of adaptation needs by a factor of 3–6×.",
    "",
    "The choices made between now and 2030 will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C.",
]:
    if ln:
        d.text((ML, y), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
    y += 68

y += 30
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 6, y + 80)], fill=VERMILION)
d.text((ML + 32, y), "Immediate, deep, and sustained emissions reductions", fill=AMBER, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 32, y + 62), "across all sectors are essential to secure a liveable future.", fill=AMBER, font=f_bbold)

# Footer
fy = H - 100
d.rectangle([(0, fy - 10), (W, fy - 8)], fill=FLINE)
d.text((ML, fy - 2), "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.", fill=MGRAY, font=f_src)
d.text((ML, fy + 36), "Presented at IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Dissemination — Climate Science Conference", fill=MGRAY, font=f_src)
d.rectangle([(0, H - 10), (W, H)], fill=VERMILION)

img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Done: {W}x{H}px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""IPCC AR6 Poster — Thermal Cartography. A0 portrait, full-height."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 4960, 7016
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE = (30, 42, 58)
DARK_SLATE = (20, 34, 50)
AMBER = (245, 166, 35)
VERMILION = (231, 76, 60)
DEEP_RED = (192, 57, 43)
TEAL = (46, 204, 157)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LGRAY = (176, 190, 197)
MGRAY = (100, 120, 140)
FLINE = (40, 58, 82)
WARM_DARK = (50, 25, 25)

def fp(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

f_title = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 168)
f_sub = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 62)
f_sec = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 88)
f_mbig = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 230)
f_mhero = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 300)
f_mlbl = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_body = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
f_bbold = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_tiny = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sval = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)
f_slbl = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_src = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_snum = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_cnum = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 200)
f_cword = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_tbig = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 280)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

ML, MR = 260, 260
CW = W - ML - MR

# Background grid
for x in range(ML, W - MR, 140):
    d.line([(x, 0), (x, H)], fill=(14, 32, 60), width=1)

# Top accent
d.rectangle([(0, 0), (W, 10)], fill=VERMILION)

y = 90
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 500, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 28
d.text((ML, y), "IPCC  AR6  SYNTHESIS  REPORT  ·  2023", fill=LGRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 72

for ln in ["Climate Change 2023", "Key Findings from the IPCC", "Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report"]:
    d.text((ML, y), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_title)
    y += 186
y += 30
d.text((ML, y), "A visual summary of the most critical findings from the IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report,", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sub)
y += 78
d.text((ML, y), "highlighting observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sub)
y += 120
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 50

# ===== 01 HEADLINE METRICS =====
st = y
sh = 1020
d.rectangle([(0, st), (W, st + sh)], fill=DARK_SLATE)
d.rectangle([(0, st), (W, st + 2)], fill=FLINE)
d.rectangle([(0, st + sh - 2), (W, st + sh)], fill=FLINE)

y = st + 30
d.text((ML, y), "01", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "HEADLINE  METRICS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 70

# Row 1
c4 = CW // 4
for i, (v, l, c) in enumerate([
    ("+1.1°C", "Global temperature rise\n2011–2020 vs 1850–1900", AMBER),
    ("410 ppm", "Atmospheric CO₂\nHighest in 2 million years", AMBER),
    ("~59 Gt", "CO₂e global emissions\n2019", AMBER),
    ("~500 Gt", "Remaining carbon budget\nfor 1.5°C (from 2020)", AMBER),
]):
    cx = ML + i * c4
    d.text((cx, y), v, fill=c, font=f_mbig)
    for j, t in enumerate(l.split("\n")):
        d.text((cx, y + 240 + j * 52), t, fill=LGRAY, font=f_mlbl)

y += 420

# Row 2 — hero metrics
c3 = CW // 3
for i, (v, l, c, hero) in enumerate([
    ("43%", "Required GHG reduction\nby 2030 for 1.5°C", VERMILION, True),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea level rise\n1901–2018", AMBER, False),
    ("3.3–3.6B", "People exposed to\nsevere climate hazards", DEEP_RED, True),
]):
    cx = ML + i * c3
    fnt = f_mhero if hero else f_mbig
    d.text((cx, y), v, fill=c, font=fnt)
    oy = y + (310 if hero else 240)
    for j, t in enumerate(l.split("\n")):
        d.text((cx, oy + j * 52), t, fill=LGRAY, font=f_mlbl)

y = st + sh + 65

# ===== 02 OBSERVED CHANGES =====
d.text((ML, y), "02", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "OBSERVED  CHANGES  AND  CURRENT  STATE", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 35

cr = ML + CW // 2 + 60
for i, ln in enumerate([
    "Global surface temperature has risen +1.1°C above",
    "pre-industrial levels. Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm —",
    "the highest concentration in at least 2 million years.",
]):
    d.text((ML, y + i * 66), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
for i, ln in enumerate([
    "Arctic sea ice has declined ~40% since 1979. Every",
    "region has experienced intensifying extreme weather",
    "events with clear attribution to human influence.",
]):
    d.text((cr, y + i * 66), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
y += 250

# Indicator bars
bh, bmw = 36, CW - 520
for i, (nm, vl, pct, col) in enumerate([
    ("Temperature", "+1.1°C", 0.55, AMBER),
    ("CO₂", "410 ppm", 0.75, AMBER),
    ("Emissions", "59 GtCO₂e", 0.65, VERMILION),
    ("Sea Level", "+0.20 m", 0.35, AMBER),
    ("Arctic Ice", "~40%", 0.40, TEAL),
]):
    by = y + i * 62
    d.text((ML, by + 4), nm, fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
    bx = ML + 370
    d.rectangle([(bx, by + 8), (bx + bmw, by + 8 + bh)], fill=FLINE)
    d.rectangle([(bx, by + 8), (bx + int(bmw * pct), by + 8 + bh)], fill=col)
    d.text((bx + bmw + 26, by + 4), vl, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += 380

d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 03 FUTURE PROJECTIONS =====
d.text((ML, y), "03", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "FUTURE  PROJECTIONS  UNDER  DIFFERENT  SCENARIOS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 40

# Horizontal thermal bars per scenario
rh = 106
lx, tx, bx0 = ML, ML + 380, ML + 740
bmx = CW - 740 - 540
dx = W - MR - 500
for i, (ssp, tmp, desc, col) in enumerate([
    ("SSP1-1.9", "~1.4°C", "Very low emissions", TEAL),
    ("SSP1-2.6", "~1.8°C", "Low emissions", (80, 180, 140)),
    ("SSP2-4.5", "~2.7°C", "Intermediate", AMBER),
    ("SSP3-7.0", "~3.6°C", "High emissions", VERMILION),
    ("SSP5-8.5", "~4.4°C", "Very high emissions", DEEP_RED),
]):
    ry = y + i * rh
    d.text((lx, ry + 14), ssp, fill=LGRAY, font=f_slbl)
    d.text((tx, ry - 8), tmp, fill=col, font=f_sval)
    tv = float(tmp.replace("~", "").replace("°C", ""))
    bl = int((tv / 5.0) * bmx)
    d.rectangle([(bx0, ry + 24), (bx0 + bl, ry + 24 + 52)], fill=col)
    d.text((dx, ry + 30), desc, fill=MGRAY, font=f_slbl)

y += 5 * rh + 25
d.text((ML, y), "Sea level rise by 2100:", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
d.text((ML + 500, y), "0.28–0.55 m", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 870, y), "(SSP1-1.9)  to", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
d.text((ML + 1170, y), "0.63–1.01 m", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 1550, y), "(SSP5-8.5)  ·  Rise continues for centuries", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
y += 100
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 04 RISKS & IMPACTS =====
d.text((ML, y), "04", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "RISKS,  VULNERABILITIES  AND  CASCADING  IMPACTS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=DEEP_RED)
y += 40

d.text((ML, y), "3.3–3.6", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_cnum)
d.text((ML + 880, y + 25), "BILLION PEOPLE", fill=WHITE, font=f_cword)
d.text((ML + 880, y + 120), "live in contexts highly vulnerable to climate change", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
y += 250

# Impact cards
cw = (CW - 100) // 3
ch = 300
for i, (title, lines, col) in enumerate([
    ("FOOD SECURITY", ["Crop yield growth slowing.", "Fisheries declining in", "tropical zones."], VERMILION),
    ("WATER STRESS", ["Over half of global population", "faces severe water scarcity", "at least 1 month per year."], AMBER),
    ("HEALTH & BIODIVERSITY", ["Heat mortality expanding.", "14% of terrestrial species face", "high extinction risk at 1.5°C."], DEEP_RED),
]):
    cx = ML + i * (cw + 50)
    d.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + cw, y + ch)], fill=SLATE)
    d.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + cw, y + 5)], fill=col)
    d.text((cx + 30, y + 28), title, fill=col, font=f_tiny)
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        d.text((cx + 30, y + 84 + j * 56), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += ch + 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 05 MITIGATION PATHWAYS =====
d.text((ML, y), "05", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "MITIGATION  AND  ADAPTATION  PATHWAYS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=TEAL)
y += 40

half = CW // 2 - 60
d.text((ML, y), "43%", fill=VERMILION, font=f_tbig)
d.text((ML, y + 290), "reduction in global GHG emissions", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
d.text((ML, y + 356), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
d.text((ML, y + 430), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2050", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)

rx = ML + half + 120
d.text((rx, y), "27%", fill=AMBER, font=f_tbig)
d.text((rx, y + 290), "reduction for 2°C pathway", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
d.text((rx, y + 356), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
d.text((rx, y + 430), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2070", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)
y += 520

d.text((ML, y), "KEY LEVERS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 52
for i, lv in enumerate(["Energy decarbonization", "Transport electrification", "Demand-side efficiency", "Carbon sink protection"]):
    lx2 = ML + i * (CW // 4)
    d.rectangle([(lx2, y + 10), (lx2 + 20, y + 30)], fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx2 + 36, y), lv, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += 90
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 50

# ===== 06 NARROWING WINDOW =====
nt = y
nh = H - nt - 120  # fill remaining
for row in range(nh):
    t = row / nh
    r = int(NAVY[0] + t * (WARM_DARK[0] - NAVY[0]))
    g = int(NAVY[1] + t * (WARM_DARK[1] - NAVY[1]))
    b = int(NAVY[2] + t * (WARM_DARK[2] - NAVY[2]))
    d.line([(0, nt + row), (W, nt + row)], fill=(r, g, b))

d.text((ML, y), "06", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "THE  NARROWING  WINDOW  FOR  ACTION", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 45

d.text((ML, y), "This decade is decisive.", fill=WHITE, font=f_sec)
y += 130

for ln in [
    "Delayed action increases costs, locks in high-carbon infrastructure, and reduces feasibility",
    "of limiting warming. Climate finance falls short of adaptation needs by a factor of 3–6×.",
    "",
    "The choices made between now and 2030 will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C.",
]:
    if ln:
        d.text((ML, y), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
    y += 68

y += 30
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 6, y + 80)], fill=VERMILION)
d.text((ML + 32, y), "Immediate, deep, and sustained emissions reductions", fill=AMBER, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 32, y + 62), "across all sectors are essential to secure a liveable future.", fill=AMBER, font=f_bbold)

# Footer
fy = H - 100
d.rectangle([(0, fy - 10), (W, fy - 8)], fill=FLINE)
d.text((ML, fy - 2), "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.", fill=MGRAY, font=f_src)
d.text((ML, fy + 36), "Presented at IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Dissemination — Climate Science Conference", fill=MGRAY, font=f_src)
d.rectangle([(0, H - 10), (W, H)], fill=VERMILION)

img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Done: {W}x{H}px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""IPCC AR6 Poster — Thermal Cartography. A0 portrait, full-height."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 4960, 7016
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE = (30, 42, 58)
DARK_SLATE = (20, 34, 50)
AMBER = (245, 166, 35)
VERMILION = (231, 76, 60)
DEEP_RED = (192, 57, 43)
TEAL = (46, 204, 157)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
LGRAY = (176, 190, 197)
MGRAY = (100, 120, 140)
FLINE = (40, 58, 82)
WARM_DARK = (50, 25, 25)

def fp(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

f_title = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 168)
f_sub = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 62)
f_sec = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 88)
f_mbig = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 230)
f_mhero = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 300)
f_mlbl = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_body = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
f_bbold = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_tiny = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sval = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)
f_slbl = fp("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_src = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_snum = fp("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_cnum = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 200)
f_cword = fp("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_tbig = fp("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 280)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

ML, MR = 260, 260
CW = W - ML - MR

# Background grid
for x in range(ML, W - MR, 140):
    d.line([(x, 0), (x, H)], fill=(14, 32, 60), width=1)

# Top accent
d.rectangle([(0, 0), (W, 10)], fill=VERMILION)

y = 90
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 500, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 28
d.text((ML, y), "IPCC  AR6  SYNTHESIS  REPORT  ·  2023", fill=LGRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 72

for ln in ["Climate Change 2023", "Key Findings from the IPCC", "Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report"]:
    d.text((ML, y), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_title)
    y += 186
y += 30
d.text((ML, y), "A visual summary of the most critical findings from the IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report,", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sub)
y += 78
d.text((ML, y), "highlighting observed changes, future projections, and urgent pathways for climate action.", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sub)
y += 120
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 50

# ===== 01 HEADLINE METRICS =====
st = y
sh = 1020
d.rectangle([(0, st), (W, st + sh)], fill=DARK_SLATE)
d.rectangle([(0, st), (W, st + 2)], fill=FLINE)
d.rectangle([(0, st + sh - 2), (W, st + sh)], fill=FLINE)

y = st + 30
d.text((ML, y), "01", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "HEADLINE  METRICS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 70

# Row 1
c4 = CW // 4
for i, (v, l, c) in enumerate([
    ("+1.1°C", "Global temperature rise\n2011–2020 vs 1850–1900", AMBER),
    ("410 ppm", "Atmospheric CO₂\nHighest in 2 million years", AMBER),
    ("~59 Gt", "CO₂e global emissions\n2019", AMBER),
    ("~500 Gt", "Remaining carbon budget\nfor 1.5°C (from 2020)", AMBER),
]):
    cx = ML + i * c4
    d.text((cx, y), v, fill=c, font=f_mbig)
    for j, t in enumerate(l.split("\n")):
        d.text((cx, y + 240 + j * 52), t, fill=LGRAY, font=f_mlbl)

y += 420

# Row 2 — hero metrics
c3 = CW // 3
for i, (v, l, c, hero) in enumerate([
    ("43%", "Required GHG reduction\nby 2030 for 1.5°C", VERMILION, True),
    ("~0.20 m", "Sea level rise\n1901–2018", AMBER, False),
    ("3.3–3.6B", "People exposed to\nsevere climate hazards", DEEP_RED, True),
]):
    cx = ML + i * c3
    fnt = f_mhero if hero else f_mbig
    d.text((cx, y), v, fill=c, font=fnt)
    oy = y + (310 if hero else 240)
    for j, t in enumerate(l.split("\n")):
        d.text((cx, oy + j * 52), t, fill=LGRAY, font=f_mlbl)

y = st + sh + 65

# ===== 02 OBSERVED CHANGES =====
d.text((ML, y), "02", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "OBSERVED  CHANGES  AND  CURRENT  STATE", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=AMBER)
y += 35

cr = ML + CW // 2 + 60
for i, ln in enumerate([
    "Global surface temperature has risen +1.1°C above",
    "pre-industrial levels. Atmospheric CO₂ reached 410 ppm —",
    "the highest concentration in at least 2 million years.",
]):
    d.text((ML, y + i * 66), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
for i, ln in enumerate([
    "Arctic sea ice has declined ~40% since 1979. Every",
    "region has experienced intensifying extreme weather",
    "events with clear attribution to human influence.",
]):
    d.text((cr, y + i * 66), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
y += 250

# Indicator bars
bh, bmw = 36, CW - 520
for i, (nm, vl, pct, col) in enumerate([
    ("Temperature", "+1.1°C", 0.55, AMBER),
    ("CO₂", "410 ppm", 0.75, AMBER),
    ("Emissions", "59 GtCO₂e", 0.65, VERMILION),
    ("Sea Level", "+0.20 m", 0.35, AMBER),
    ("Arctic Ice", "~40%", 0.40, TEAL),
]):
    by = y + i * 62
    d.text((ML, by + 4), nm, fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
    bx = ML + 370
    d.rectangle([(bx, by + 8), (bx + bmw, by + 8 + bh)], fill=FLINE)
    d.rectangle([(bx, by + 8), (bx + int(bmw * pct), by + 8 + bh)], fill=col)
    d.text((bx + bmw + 26, by + 4), vl, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += 380

d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 03 FUTURE PROJECTIONS =====
d.text((ML, y), "03", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "FUTURE  PROJECTIONS  UNDER  DIFFERENT  SCENARIOS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 40

# Horizontal thermal bars per scenario
rh = 106
lx, tx, bx0 = ML, ML + 380, ML + 740
bmx = CW - 740 - 540
dx = W - MR - 500
for i, (ssp, tmp, desc, col) in enumerate([
    ("SSP1-1.9", "~1.4°C", "Very low emissions", TEAL),
    ("SSP1-2.6", "~1.8°C", "Low emissions", (80, 180, 140)),
    ("SSP2-4.5", "~2.7°C", "Intermediate", AMBER),
    ("SSP3-7.0", "~3.6°C", "High emissions", VERMILION),
    ("SSP5-8.5", "~4.4°C", "Very high emissions", DEEP_RED),
]):
    ry = y + i * rh
    d.text((lx, ry + 14), ssp, fill=LGRAY, font=f_slbl)
    d.text((tx, ry - 8), tmp, fill=col, font=f_sval)
    tv = float(tmp.replace("~", "").replace("°C", ""))
    bl = int((tv / 5.0) * bmx)
    d.rectangle([(bx0, ry + 24), (bx0 + bl, ry + 24 + 52)], fill=col)
    d.text((dx, ry + 30), desc, fill=MGRAY, font=f_slbl)

y += 5 * rh + 25
d.text((ML, y), "Sea level rise by 2100:", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
d.text((ML + 500, y), "0.28–0.55 m", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 870, y), "(SSP1-1.9)  to", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
d.text((ML + 1170, y), "0.63–1.01 m", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 1550, y), "(SSP5-8.5)  ·  Rise continues for centuries", fill=LGRAY, font=f_sm)
y += 100
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 04 RISKS & IMPACTS =====
d.text((ML, y), "04", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "RISKS,  VULNERABILITIES  AND  CASCADING  IMPACTS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=DEEP_RED)
y += 40

d.text((ML, y), "3.3–3.6", fill=DEEP_RED, font=f_cnum)
d.text((ML + 880, y + 25), "BILLION PEOPLE", fill=WHITE, font=f_cword)
d.text((ML + 880, y + 120), "live in contexts highly vulnerable to climate change", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
y += 250

# Impact cards
cw = (CW - 100) // 3
ch = 300
for i, (title, lines, col) in enumerate([
    ("FOOD SECURITY", ["Crop yield growth slowing.", "Fisheries declining in", "tropical zones."], VERMILION),
    ("WATER STRESS", ["Over half of global population", "faces severe water scarcity", "at least 1 month per year."], AMBER),
    ("HEALTH & BIODIVERSITY", ["Heat mortality expanding.", "14% of terrestrial species face", "high extinction risk at 1.5°C."], DEEP_RED),
]):
    cx = ML + i * (cw + 50)
    d.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + cw, y + ch)], fill=SLATE)
    d.rectangle([(cx, y), (cx + cw, y + 5)], fill=col)
    d.text((cx + 30, y + 28), title, fill=col, font=f_tiny)
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        d.text((cx + 30, y + 84 + j * 56), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += ch + 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 60

# ===== 05 MITIGATION PATHWAYS =====
d.text((ML, y), "05", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "MITIGATION  AND  ADAPTATION  PATHWAYS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 280, y + 3)], fill=TEAL)
y += 40

half = CW // 2 - 60
d.text((ML, y), "43%", fill=VERMILION, font=f_tbig)
d.text((ML, y + 290), "reduction in global GHG emissions", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
d.text((ML, y + 356), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
d.text((ML, y + 430), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2050", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)

rx = ML + half + 120
d.text((rx, y), "27%", fill=AMBER, font=f_tbig)
d.text((rx, y + 290), "reduction for 2°C pathway", fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
d.text((rx, y + 356), "below 2019 levels by 2030", fill=LGRAY, font=f_body)
d.text((rx, y + 430), "Net zero CO₂ by ~2070", fill=TEAL, font=f_bbold)
y += 520

d.text((ML, y), "KEY LEVERS", fill=MGRAY, font=f_tiny)
y += 52
for i, lv in enumerate(["Energy decarbonization", "Transport electrification", "Demand-side efficiency", "Carbon sink protection"]):
    lx2 = ML + i * (CW // 4)
    d.rectangle([(lx2, y + 10), (lx2 + 20, y + 30)], fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx2 + 36, y), lv, fill=WHITE, font=f_sm)
y += 90
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 2)], fill=FLINE)
y += 50

# ===== 06 NARROWING WINDOW =====
nt = y
nh = H - nt - 120  # fill remaining
for row in range(nh):
    t = row / nh
    r = int(NAVY[0] + t * (WARM_DARK[0] - NAVY[0]))
    g = int(NAVY[1] + t * (WARM_DARK[1] - NAVY[1]))
    b = int(NAVY[2] + t * (WARM_DARK[2] - NAVY[2]))
    d.line([(0, nt + row), (W, nt + row)], fill=(r, g, b))

d.text((ML, y), "06", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
d.text((ML + 70, y), "THE  NARROWING  WINDOW  FOR  ACTION", fill=MGRAY, font=f_snum)
y += 65
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (W - MR, y + 3)], fill=VERMILION)
y += 45

d.text((ML, y), "This decade is decisive.", fill=WHITE, font=f_sec)
y += 130

for ln in [
    "Delayed action increases costs, locks in high-carbon infrastructure, and reduces feasibility",
    "of limiting warming. Climate finance falls short of adaptation needs by a factor of 3–6×.",
    "",
    "The choices made between now and 2030 will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C.",
]:
    if ln:
        d.text((ML, y), ln, fill=WHITE, font=f_body)
    y += 68

y += 30
d.rectangle([(ML, y), (ML + 6, y + 80)], fill=VERMILION)
d.text((ML + 32, y), "Immediate, deep, and sustained emissions reductions", fill=AMBER, font=f_bbold)
d.text((ML + 32, y + 62), "across all sectors are essential to secure a liveable future.", fill=AMBER, font=f_bbold)

# Footer
fy = H - 100
d.rectangle([(0, fy - 10), (W, fy - 8)], fill=FLINE)
d.text((ML, fy - 2), "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.", fill=MGRAY, font=f_src)
d.text((ML, fy + 36), "Presented at IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Dissemination — Climate Science Conference", fill=MGRAY, font=f_src)
d.rectangle([(0, H - 10), (W, H)], fill=VERMILION)

img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Done: {W}x{H}px")

steps.message:
The poster now fills the full A0 portrait frame with clean hierarchy, clear sections, and good use of space. The narrative arc flows from top to bottom: header → headline metrics → observed changes → future projections → risks → mitigation → narrowing window. The thermal color palette progresses from amber to vermilion to deep red, and the two hero metrics (43% and 3.3-3.6B) stand out with larger type and stronger colors.

The poster is saved at `/app/output/final_poster.png` (4960×7016px, 150 DPI, A0 portrait) alongside the design philosophy at `/app/output/design_philosophy.md`.
